requirement: FastAPI POST /telemetry/bulk endpoint inserting batches of readings using SQLAlchemy 2.0 multi-row insert with .returning() in strictly 1 INSERT statement per 50-row batch, committing generated IDs.
skeleton: FastAPI POST /telemetry/bulk with SQLAlchemy bulk multi-row insert and returning.

rationale.teaches: A SQLAlchemy 2.0 multi-row insert with returning: one INSERT per batch, a commit, a rejected empty payload, every row included, and the generated ids echoed back.
rationale.why: A per-row loop returns the same ids as a bulk insert, so only a statement count separates them. The family makes the statement count and the id echo part of the contract a generator must meet.

candidates.why_wrong: Each reading is inserted with its own statement, so a 50-row batch issues 50 INSERTs instead of one.
The batch is flushed but never committed, so the rows disappear when the session closes.
An empty readings list is accepted and answered 200 instead of rejected with 400.
The last reading in every batch is sliced off before insert, so each batch persists one row short.
returning is dropped, so the response reports a count but an empty ids list.
